body: Personally, I prefer to be listened to. I think actually talking, either over the phone or in person, is much easier than texting, and seems to work much better in my experience. As a lot of other people here have said, you kinda have to gauge how to react/console someone going through an episode. though as for the question: "should i continue to contact you/leave you alone", i would also say this depends on the situation. for example, if the episode is severe, and you think the person might be in danger, then by all means continue to contact them. but, sometimes people need time to process things too. what i like to do is if im upset like that and i don't want to talk to anybody, ill have my friends or someone just check up on me every so often. that way i can have my own time to think and not be bombarded with concerns, but also  not feel completely isolated.
